title: I text my AI agent and it edits my reels (AGENT-16 carousel, 76-hermes-edits-reels-house)
summary: Metricool: scheduled Fri 30 Oct 13:00 IG + TikTok
body: Metricool: scheduled Fri 30 Oct 13:00 IG + TikTok
guide: An AI agent you message from your phone that trims and captions your short videos, then schedules the finished reel. You need a Telegram account, an AI coding assistant (Claude Code or Codex), ffmpeg, a Google Drive folder, and a Metricool account.
1. Create a Telegram bot with BotFather and keep its token somewhere private, not in your code.
1. Make a Google Drive folder for raw clips and a second one for finished videos.
1. In Claude Code or Codex, build a small program that listens to your bot and treats your messages as editing instructions, such as "cut the pauses" or "add captions".
1. Have the program download the clip from Google Drive and run ffmpeg to cut, resize to 9:16 and burn in the captions.
1. Save the result to the finished folder and send a preview back to Telegram so you can approve it or ask for changes.
1. Once you approve, have the program create the scheduled post through Metricool for Instagram and TikTok, with your caption and a time.
1. Make the program reply with what it changed on each version, so you can check it from your phone.
Watch out: let the agent schedule only after you approve the preview, and keep your tokens in environment variables, never in the code or in chat.

```
You are helping me build a personal video-editing agent that I control by text message. I use <operating system> and have <Claude Code or Codex>, ffmpeg, a Telegram account, Google Drive and a Metricool account on <plan name>.
Build a small program in <Python or Node> that does this:
1. Listens to my Telegram bot, but only replies to my own user ID.
2. When I send an instruction such as "cut the pauses and add captions", it fetches the newest clip from my Google Drive folder <raw clips folder>.
3. Edits the clip with ffmpeg: trims silence, converts to 9:16, and adds captions from a transcript.
4. Saves the result to <finished folder> and sends me a preview in Telegram with a short list of what changed.
5. Only after I reply "approve" does it schedule the video through the Metricool API for <Instagram and TikTok> at <time>, using <my caption>.
Constraints: read all tokens from environment variables, never hard-code them, keep every previous version of a video, and log each step in plain English.
Return the project structure, the full code, setup steps for each service, and how to test it with one sample clip before connecting Metricool.
```
